generic.title: An unexpected error occurred
generic.description: Please try again. If the issue persists, check your network and settings.
generic.network: Network connection failed. Check your internet connection or proxy settings.
generic.timeout: The request timed out. Please try again.
generic.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check your API keys in Settings.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY_REQUIRED.title: YouTube API Key Required
YOUTUBE_API_KEY_REQUIRED.suggestion: Configure a valid YouTube Data API key in Settings.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY_INVALID.title: YouTube API Key Invalid
YOUTUBE_API_KEY_INVALID.suggestion: Check that the YouTube Data API key is correct and enabled in Google Cloud Console.

YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: YouTube API Quota Exceeded
YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.suggestion: Your daily YouTube Data API quota has been exhausted. Wait for quota reset or use another key.

YOUTUBE_NETWORK.title: YouTube Connection Failed
YOUTUBE_NETWORK.suggestion: Unable to reach YouTube API. Check your internet connection, proxy settings, or firewall.

YOUTUBE_REQUEST_REJECTED.title: YouTube Request Rejected
YOUTUBE_REQUEST_REJECTED.suggestion: YouTube rejected the search query or parameters. Review filters and try again.

GEMINI_API_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Gemini API Key Required
GEMINI_API_KEY_REQUIRED.suggestion: Configure your Gemini API key in Settings to use AI features.

GEMINI_API_KEY_INVALID.title: Gemini API Key Invalid
GEMINI_API_KEY_INVALID.suggestion: Check that your Gemini API key is valid in Google AI Studio.

GEMINI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Gemini Quota Exceeded
GEMINI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.suggestion: AI rate limit reached. Please wait a moment before trying again.

GEMINI_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_PROVIDER_FAILUR.title: Research Insights Failed
GEMINI_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_PROVIDER_FAILUR.suggestion: Gemini could not complete the research analysis. Retry or check your API key.

GEMINI_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_INVALID.title: Invalid Research Insights
GEMINI_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_INVALID.suggestion: Gemini returned an unparseable response. Retry to request a fresh generation.

GEMINI_IDEA_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.title: Idea Generation Failed
GEMINI_IDEA_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.suggestion: Gemini failed to generate grounded ideas. Please retry.

GEMINI_IDEA_GENERATION_INVALID.title: Invalid Grounded Ideas
GEMINI_IDEA_GENERATION_INVALID.suggestion: Generated ideas did not match evidence constraints. Please retry.

GEMINI_SCRIPT_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILUR.title: Script Generation Failed
GEMINI_SCRIPT_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILUR.suggestion: Gemini could not generate the script. Check connection or retry.

GEMINI_SCRIPT_GENERATION_INVALID.title: Invalid Script Response
GEMINI_SCRIPT_GENERATION_INVALID.suggestion: The generated script format was invalid. Please retry.

GEMINI_IMAGE_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.title: Thumbnail Generation Failed
GEMINI_IMAGE_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.suggestion: Gemini image model failed to generate thumbnail. Check your image model settings.

CUSTOM_TEXT_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_PROVIDER_F.title: Custom Provider Insights Failed
CUSTOM_TEXT_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_PROVIDER_F.suggestion: The custom text AI provider failed. Check Base URL, API key, and model status.

CUSTOM_TEXT_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_INVALID.title: Custom Provider Response Invalid
CUSTOM_TEXT_RESEARCH_INSIGHTS_INVALID.suggestion: Custom provider returned an unparseable response for research insights.

CUSTOM_TEXT_IDEA_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAI.title: Custom Provider Idea Generation Failed
CUSTOM_TEXT_IDEA_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAI.suggestion: Custom text provider failed to generate ideas. Verify endpoint availability.

CUSTOM_TEXT_IDEA_GENERATION_INVALID.title: Custom Provider Ideas Invalid
CUSTOM_TEXT_IDEA_GENERATION_INVALID.suggestion: Custom provider ideas failed evidence schema validation.

CUSTOM_TEXT_SCRIPT_GENERATION_PROVIDER_F.title: Custom Provider Script Generation Failed
CUSTOM_TEXT_SCRIPT_GENERATION_PROVIDER_F.suggestion: Custom text provider failed during script generation.

CUSTOM_TEXT_SCRIPT_GENERATION_INVALID.title: Custom Provider Script Invalid
CUSTOM_TEXT_SCRIPT_GENERATION_INVALID.suggestion: Custom provider script output failed schema validation.

CUSTOM_IMAGE_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.title: Custom Image Provider Failed
CUSTOM_IMAGE_GENERATION_PROVIDER_FAILURE.suggestion: Custom image generation failed or the provider is currently unsupported.

THUMBNAIL_REQUEST_INVALID.title: Invalid Thumbnail Request
THUMBNAIL_REQUEST_INVALID.suggestion: Review thumbnail settings and reference image formats, then try again.
